Three hoisted 180s runs: BASE, a counterfactual with all skill1 flatDamage stripped, and one with the burst weaponSwap + unlimitedAmmo stripped. An explicit non-vacuity test asserts nayuta actually casts — crown is also Burst II, so if the rotation starves nayuta of casts the fixture (not the override) is what must change; castFrames additionally falls back to the frames of her own 15s burst aura if burstCast events are not per-unit.

hitRatePct → core-rate conversion magnitude is the engine's ⚑ measurement-gated HRCORE path; this file asserts the stack bookkeeping (1.4/stack, cap 30, 3s cadence) but deliberately does not pin the derived core lift.

Whether the 380.46% 'stage target' line is a separate block or a second effect on the full-charge block is unresolvable from the prose; the assertion is written on the SUM of skill1 flatDamage atkPct so both encodings pass.

Packet-internal contradiction on the OverrideFile slot shape (bare Block[] vs CharacterSkills.blocks) — blocksOf() accepts either so the counterfactuals are correct under whichever is real; flagged rather than silently assumed.
